description: Start an AI visibility check: does the business appear when AI assistants are asked for local providers in its city? It uses up to five prompts to the configured OpenAI model. Paid, drawn from a shared daily budget; when the budget is used up the result says quota_reached with the UTC reset time. For a running result, wait pollAfterSeconds, then call get_audit_report with runId. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.

name: check_ai_visibility
